About Me

Hi, I'm Awais — I Help Brands Win on Google & AI Search.

I'm Syed Awais Tahir, an SEO expert with 2 years of hands-on experience, working with businesses in the USA, UK and worldwide. My speciality is helping brands get found, cited and recommended — not just in Google's results, but in the AI answers your customers now read first.

I handle the full search picture myself: technical audits and fixes, keyword and intent research, on-page optimisation, WordPress SEO, white-hat authority building, and AEO/GEO strategies that put your brand inside AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Gemini responses.

No account managers, no hand-offs, no black-hat shortcuts. You get a clear plan, honest reporting, and an expert who treats your growth like his own.

How It Works

A Simple Process. Serious Results.

No jargon, no guesswork. You always know what's being done, why it matters, and what comes next.

01

AUDIT & RESEARCH

02
